correctness.rationale: Basis extension proves the complete VC support characterization. Edmonds matroid intersection gives d=min_A(2r(A)+|E-A|-r(E)). For a nonloop/noncoloop e, the restricted rank objectives are F_M(X)-1 for deletion and F_M(X+e)-1 for contraction. Their minima partition all subsets of E, yielding d=1+min(d deletion,d contraction). The Littlestone split recurrence then proves equality inductively; loops and coloops are constant coordinates. Selected binary, uniform, partition and graphic examples and a nonmatroid contrast were independently recomputed using the embedded checker.

value.rationale: A single theorem characterizes all shattered supports and computes the adaptive rank for every finite matroid from a classical min--max formula, including nonrepresentable cases. The pointwise deletion/contraction recurrence provides a structural online proof, and the dimension equality transfers polynomial-time matroid-intersection evaluation to online mistake-tree depth. This is an explanatory classification, not an arbitrary small instance.
